_readme: Far-field depth pixelation. Distant scene pixels are grouped and depth-aware averaged after SSR but before palette quantization. This is intentionally a retro depth resolve rather than photographic bokeh.

docs.enabled: Enables the far-field depth pixelation pass. This is a Tier 1 live update and does not rebuild materials or regenerate the dungeon.

distance.sharpUntil: World-space distance that remains completely sharp. Keep this beyond immediate combat and interaction range.
distance.fullEffectAt: World-space distance where the configured maximum pixel block and filter strength are reached. Runtime validation keeps this above Sharp Until.
distance.curve: Shapes the distance ramp. Values above 1 delay the visible effect toward the far distance; values below 1 bring it forward.

pixelation.maxBlockPixels: Largest screen-space pixel block at Full Effect At. Four is subtle at 640x360; eight or more is deliberately stylized.
pixelation.strength: Blends between the original scene and the depth-pixelated result without changing the distance ramp.
pixelation.referenceHeight: Internal render height at which Max Block Pixels is authored.
pixelation.scaleWithResolution: Scales block size relative to Reference Height so the effect has the same apparent size at other internal resolutions.

filter.pattern: Sampling pattern inside each pixel block. Nearest is cheapest; Cross 5 is the recommended anti-moire default; Box 9 is the smoothest and most expensive.
filter.strength: Amount of depth-aware area averaging inside each distant pixel block. Zero keeps pure nearest pixelation.
filter.radius: How far samples spread across a pixel block. Values near 0.65 reduce distant texture shimmer without making silhouettes mushy.

edge.absoluteThreshold: Maximum absolute world-space depth difference accepted by the block filter before a sample is rejected as another surface.
edge.relativeThreshold: Additional accepted depth difference proportional to the current distance. This keeps far coplanar surfaces filtered while protecting silhouettes.

debug.view: Diagnostic output: depth, effect factor, selected block size, or rejected-sample ratio. Off renders the final effect.
